stem: The value of escape velocity of a body from the earth's surface is \(V_{esc} =\) ______.
solution: The escape velocity is the minimum velocity needed to project a body so that it escapes the earth's gravitational field. Equating kinetic energy to gravitational potential energy, \(\frac{1}{2}mV_{esc}^2 = \frac{GMm}{R}\), giving \(V_{esc} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2GM}{R}}\). Correct option: C.

stem: In ______ of the modern periodic table, are the non-metals found.
solution: Non-metals occupy the right-hand side of the modern periodic table (Groups 13 to 18, except some metals/metalloids), which belongs to the \(p\)-block. The \(s\)-block and \(d\)-block, \(f\)-block contain metals. Correct option: B.

stem: The resistance of the wire is \(100\ \Omega\). If it is carrying a current of \(1\ A\) for \(10\) seconds, the heat produced will be ______.
solution: By Joule's law of heating, \(H = I^2 R t = (1)^2 \times 100 \times 10 = 1000\ J\). Correct option: D.

stem: The refractive index of diamond is ______.
solution: Diamond has the highest refractive index among common materials, \(2.42\); this large value is why light undergoes strong bending and total internal reflection in it, giving diamond its sparkle. (1.54 is glass, 1.36 is alcohol, 1.50 is a typical glass value.) Correct option: A.

subtopic: Human Eye and Defects of Vision
stem: For normal human eye, the minimum distance of distinct vision is ______.
solution: The least distance of distinct vision for a normal human eye is \(25\) cm — the nearest distance at which the eye can see an object clearly without strain. Correct option: C.

stem: Find odd man out: Cooking of food, Ripening of fruit, Milk turned into curd, Transformation of ice into water.
solution: Odd man out: Transformation of ice into water. Cooking of food, ripening of fruit and milk turning into curd are chemical changes (new substances are formed and the change is irreversible), whereas the transformation of ice into water is only a physical change (change of state; no new substance is formed and it is reversible).

stem: By observing the correlation in the first pair, complete the second pair: Mass : Kilogram : : Weight : ______.
solution: Newton. The SI unit of mass is the kilogram, and the SI unit of weight (which is a force, \(W = mg\)) is the newton (N).

stem: State whether the following statement is true or false: 'The volume of water at \(4\ ^{\circ}\)C is maximum'.
solution: False. Due to the anomalous behaviour of water, the volume of a given mass of water is minimum (and its density is maximum) at \(4\ ^{\circ}\)C, not maximum.

| Thermometer | (a) Mechanical energy |
|  | (b) To measure temperature |

solution: Thermometer \(\rightarrow\) (b) To measure temperature. A thermometer is the instrument used to measure the temperature of a body. [(a) Mechanical energy and (c) an ammeter/galvanometer 'to measure electric current' are the distractors.]

stem: What is the wavelength of violet ray in dispersion of light?
solution: The wavelength of violet light is about \(400\) nm (\(4000\) angstrom), which is the shortest wavelength in the visible spectrum. Because of this shortest wavelength, violet light is refracted (deviated) the most during dispersion.
